def solve_n_queens(n):
    def backtrack(row, diagonals, anti_diagonals, cols, state):
        if row == n:
            return state
        for col in range(n):
            curr_diagonal = row - col
            curr_anti_diagonal = row + col
            if (col in cols or 
                curr_diagonal in diagonals or 
                curr_anti_diagonal in anti_diagonals):
                continue
            
            cols.add(col)
            diagonals.add(curr_diagonal)
            anti_diagonals.add(curr_anti_diagonal)
            state.append(col)
            
            res = backtrack(row + 1, diagonals, anti_diagonals, cols, state)
            if res:
                return res
            
            cols.remove(col)
            diagonals.remove(curr_diagonal)
            anti_diagonals.remove(curr_anti_diagonal)
            state.pop()
        return None

    return backtrack(0, set(), set(), set(), [])

print(solve_n_queens(26))

def verify(solution):
    n = len(solution)
    cols = set()
    diags = set()
    anti_diags = set()
    for r, c in enumerate(solution):
        if c in cols or (r - c) in diags or (r + c) in anti_diags:
            return False
        cols.add(c)
        diags.add(r - c)
        anti_diags.add(r + c)
    return True
